name: Anthropic Claude
label: Anthropic Claude
description: Official Anthropic Claude API (Messages + Files) on the v2 agent model contract (INPUT llm_input → OUTPUT llm_output). operation selects chat (POST /v1/messages) or Files CRUD. Thinking-capable Claude models (claude-3-7, claude-*-4+) auto-enable extended thinking (budget derived from max_tokens, sampling knobs dropped per API rules) so reasoning streams on the thinking channel; an explicit thinking config always wins. Auth is StudioQuack secret api_key sent as x-api-key. File/image/PDF payloads use type file (platform ref-id). Docs: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/overview. Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/terms. Never log api_key. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: llm_input
ports.description: v2 LLM request so this node can sit on the AI Agent model FUNCTION port. Shape: {messages, tools?, stream?, model?, max_tokens?, file?, file_id?, limit?, page?}. Image/PDF use type file (platform ref-id), never inline bytes. Do not put api_key here.

schema.label: messages
schema.description: Conversation for operation=chat. List of {role, content}. content is string or typed blocks (text / image / document). Image and PDF sources use type file (platform ref-id). Example: [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}].

schema.label: tools
schema.description: Optional tool definitions {name, description, request} mapped to Anthropic input_schema. Omit or [] sends no tools.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Platform file ref-id for files_upload. Never inline bytes. Max 500 MB per Anthropic Files docs.

schema.label: file_id
schema.description: Anthropic file id (file_…) for files_get and files_delete.

schema.label: inputFiles
schema.description: user-uploaded files and voice clips for the model

children.label: kind
children.description: File kind: image, document, audio, or video.

children.label: mime_type
children.description: RFC 1521 media type, e.g. application/pdf, image/png

children.label: source
children.description: How the payload is carried: base64 or url.

children.label: data
children.description: base64-encoded payload (when source=base64) or absolute URL (when source=url)

children.label: name
children.description: Original filename, surfaced as the upload name

ports.name: llm_output
ports.description: v2 LLM response envelope. Success includes status/data from OfficialApiNode. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed Anthropic JSON (message, file metadata, or list).

schema.label: outputFiles
schema.description: files produced by the model, e.g. generated images/audio

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official Anthropic verb. EXACT values: chat | files_upload | files_get | files_list | files_delete. Default chat = POST /v1/messages.

configurationParameters.label: API Key
configurationParameters.description: Anthropic Console API key. Sent as header x-api-key. StudioQuack secret binding only. Never logged. Empty → error 'api_key is required'.

configurationParameters.label: Model
configurationParameters.description: Messages model id. Default claude-sonnet-5 (current Sonnet). Current production lineup: claude-fable-5, claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-haiku-4-5 (alias) / claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Still available previous: claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-4-7, claude-opus-4-6, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-sonnet-4-5 / claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929, claude-opus-4-5. claude-sonnet-4-5 remains valid (alias of the 20250929 snapshot) until not sooner than 2026-09-29. Verify live list via GET /v1/models. Docs: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview .

configurationParameters.label: Max tokens
configurationParameters.description: Messages max_tokens (API required). Default 1024. Positive integer.

configurationParameters.label: Stream
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: controls whether Anthropic Claude requests a streamed completion and fans live deltas through helper emitPartial. Canonical flag. When true the node POSTs stream:true, parses SSE data: lines, emitPartial("thinking", delta) for reasoning/thinking and emitPartial("answer", delta) for content; thoughts also appear on llm_output.result.thoughts / thinking; finish_reason, usage and tool_calls are assembled at the end. Accepted: select true | false. Default: true. Invalid/blank → true. Example: true.
